newsitem.title: SENEGAL: Senegal puts state airline up for sale.
newsitem.headline: Senegal puts state airline up for sale.

text.p: Senegal put its national carrier Air Senegal up for sale to a strategic partner on Monday as part of its privatisation programme.
"The government of Senegal pledges to cede 51 percent of the capital of the company to a strategic partner," the state privatisation committee said in a statement.
Air Senegal has an 18 seater Twin Otter plane and 116 staff, an official of Air Senegal told Reuters.
The closing date for tenders is July 14. For further details, contact Serigne Ahmadou Kamara of the privatisation committee by telephone on +221 23 34 28 or 23 34 29 or by fax on 22 56 31.
